segments.ja20:1.3: Naḷena vāriṃ pissāma [pivissāma (sī. syā. pī.)], neva [na ca (ka.)] maṃ tvaṃ vadhissasīti.
segments.ja20:4.1: Atha lakkhaṇa sākha dhiratthu puna, na kiratthi rasehi kharādiyā;
segments.ja20:4.3: Atibhoti vara [rasa (sabbattha)] māluta pāṇa, muccena naḷaavhayanena bhavanti dasāti.

lines: Tassattho – mayaṃ tava pokkharaṇiyaṃ naḷena pānīyaṃ pivissāmāti.
